label: Accelerating Expansion
description: Krauss: the red-shift rate is increasing — the cosmos is flying apart, hardly careful tuning.
name: accelerating-expansion

label: Borrowing Charge Is False
description: Conscience is innate (Socrates, Smith); no borrowing from theism is required.
name: borrowing-charge-is-false

label: Cause Need Not Choose
description: 'I don't have to know' the origin; positing a choosing being just relabels the mystery.
name: cause-need-not-choose

label: Hume's Premise Is Wrong
description: Hume's 'regular beats rare' rule would deny the Big Bang and one's own birth — singular events happen.
name: hume's-premise-is-wrong

label: I Am A Primate And Still Reason
description: Being a primate doesn't bar reasoning about heroism and self-sacrifice.
name: i-am-a-primate-and-still-reason

label: Information Argument Is Faith
description: The origin-of-life quotes are all statements of uncertainty, not evidence of a mind.
name: information-argument-is-faith

label: Morality Predates Atoms
description: The question of the good predates Lucretius, Democritus, and Epicurus and the atomic theory; it needs no deity.
name: morality-predates-atoms

label: Nature Is The Greater Abortion Provider
description: A false distinction: nature, not God, ends most pregnancies; the unborn has a real claim, but that is no moral equivalent to a commanded genocide.
name: nature-is-the-greater-abortion-provider

label: Not All Pardons Are Immoral
description: Hitchens clarifies: not all pardons — only assuming another's responsibility — are immoral.
name: not-all-pardons-are-immoral

label: Optimality Objection Misfires
description: Profuse extinction and a heat-death trajectory are not what design predicts.
name: optimality-objection-misfires

label: Religious People Aren't The Point
description: Bad believers say nothing about whether God exists; everything poisons religion.
name: religious-people-aren't-the-point
